summary: Release the full checkpoint capture after planning, before a retry capture and before trimming starts.

replay.detail: No claim replay or history rewriting.

rules.detail: The selected plan, certificate checks, drop digest and trim progress are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No wire, claim or manifest changes.

downtime.detail: No restart requirement beyond the normal binary update.

recovery.detail: Committed trim chunks still resume after a process stop. The capture itself and the deletion of one envelope stay unbounded.
